title: Arc5/Arc4 cleaning indicator on
fullDescription:
Panasonic Arc5 and Arc4 light a small cleaning icon after the recommended use cycle. Rinse heads under tap with motor running.

Icon clears automatically after a clean cycle.

fixSteps.title: Rinse with water
fixSteps.instruction: Hold under hot tap, motor on, 30s.

fixSteps.title: Or run station cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Press start on Cleaning & Charging Station.

faq.a: A drop of dish soap is OK; rinse thoroughly.

title: Foil/blade replacement icon
fullDescription:
Panasonic recommends foil and blade replacement every 12-18 months for Arc5/Arc4. Replacement icon (often shown as 12) lights when interval is met.

Use WES9032 (Arc5) or WES9013 (Arc4).

fixSteps.title: Replace foil
fixSteps.instruction: Press release; lift outer foil out, snap new in.

fixSteps.title: Replace inner blades
fixSteps.instruction: Pull each inner blade out, push new in.

faq.a: Foil and blade should be replaced together for best shave.

title: Arc5 battery near empty
fullDescription:
1-bar flashing means under 5 minutes runtime. Quick-charge: 5 minutes for one shave.

If 1-bar after full charge, NiMH or Li-ion pack needs swap.

fixSteps.title: Battery swap
fixSteps.instruction: Open shell; replace cell with tabs (model-specific).

faq.a: Modern Li-ion no — older NiMH yes; cycle once a month.

title: Panasonic shaver dead
fullDescription:
Common causes: lost adapter (Panasonic uses RE7-87/RE9-31), depleted battery in protect mode, or power-button membrane wear.

Leave on charger 24h before declaring dead.

fixSteps.title: Verify adapter
fixSteps.instruction: Multimeter reads correct DC voltage on tip.

faq.a: Models share RE7/RE9 family but verify exact model number.

title: Cleaning station error
fullDescription:
Panasonic Cleaning & Charging Station shows an error LED when fluid is low, drain blocked, or shaver not seated.

Most commonly the drain trap is hair-clogged — empty and rinse.

fixSteps.title: Empty fluid bath
fixSteps.instruction: Lift bath; pour out used fluid.

fixSteps.title: Rinse drain
fixSteps.instruction: Run hot water through drain trap.

faq.a: 70% isopropyl works as substitute; chip will not log usage.

title: Linear motor weak
fullDescription:
Arc5 linear motor drives at 14,000 cpm. If output feels weak (slower whine), foils are clogged or magnet has shifted.

Deep clean, then check by running unloaded — should sound bright.

fixSteps.title: Hot rinse
fixSteps.instruction: Run with motor on under hot tap 60s.

fixSteps.title: Lubricate
fixSteps.instruction: Drop of Panasonic ES003P oil on inner blades.

whenToCallPro: If motor remains weak after clean and oil.

faq.a: OK in pinch but Panasonic oil is purpose-blended.

title: Pop-up trimmer jammed
fullDescription:
Hair and skin oil bind in slider rails. Wet rinse and exercise motion to free.

Never oil rails — capillary action draws oil into motor cavity.

fixSteps.title: Hot rinse
fixSteps.instruction: Hold under hot tap, work slider 20x.

faq.a: Only on cutter blades — not slider rails.

title: Water-drop icon flashing
fullDescription: Some Arc5 models flash a water icon when used in cordless mode under water for safety reminder. Press power once to acknowledge — no fault.

title: Shave painful, hair pulled
shortDescription: Inner blades dull or foil cracked.
fullDescription:
If shaver pulls but motor sounds healthy, the inner cutting blades are dull or the foil has hairline cracks letting hair lodge between layers.

Replace inner blade and outer foil set as a kit.

fixSteps.title: Inspect foil
fixSteps.instruction: Hold to light — looking for hairline cracks.

videoSearchQuery: Panasonic Arc5 hair pulling foil crack

faq.a: Inner blades dull at same rate — replace as kit.

title: Self-test failure
fullDescription:
All segment LEDs flashing = POST failed. Hard reset by holding power 10s with adapter unplugged.

If flashing returns, controller PCB needs service.
